newsitem.title: GERMANY: German regional station forms new ad unit.
newsitem.headline: German regional station forms new ad unit.

text.p: German regional station NDR said on Wednesday it had formed a new advertising and marketing unit with a focus on event organisation, merchandising and licensing as well as selling ad time.
The new subsidiary, NDR Media GmbH, will also serve as a finance and strategy holding company for other NDR units.
Lutz Marmor and Martin Willich will serve as managing directors. Both were previously directors of Studio Hamburg GmbH, which is one of Germany's largest film and television studios.
